item: Row 384: a backup member at an app key name that is a folder, pipe, device or link, or larger than any key file, is refused unread and the import goes on
summary: The key restore read each member at an app key name with path.read_bytes(): a folder there raised and failed the whole import, a FIFO blocked it for ever, a link to /dev/zero read without end, and any size was read whole. merge._read_key_member now opens it with src.backup.regular_file.open_regular (no link followed, never blocks, only a regular file) and reads at most src.custody.keyfile.MAX_KEY_FILE_BYTES + 1 bytes (the row 341 bound for key files); anything else is refused with 'not a regular file, or larger than any key file, so it was not read; it is not written and stays in the backup' (x12), and the rest of its pair is refused with it (R811). The import goes on. Tests: folder, FIFO, link to /dev/zero, one byte over the cap, exactly the cap, a refused half refusing its pair, x12.
